title: GitHub

signIn.hint: Sign in in the capture browser first; staff accounts get a Site admin toggle (removed at build).

rules.note: The staff-only "Site admin mode" toggle (a form, in the footer and hidden in the page), with its list item.

The code view paints code as a bitmap mask made in the page (a blob: image), which a capture can't keep, so the code came out as a solid block. Its own transparent text layer is shown instead, in the default text color, without syntax colors.

Files changed: every diff is laid out (GitHub skips off-screen ones with content-visibility: auto, so the page's height depended on what was drawn first). Its sticky toolbar is opaque, as on GitHub once its script marks it stuck.

Copilot settings pages (org and repo code review): each setting's title (h4.Heading__toON9Z) gets its size from a var() font shorthand Chrome can't write back out of the live page, so titles came out 32 px. Only these pages: on the enterprise AI controls page the same fix brings out a "More" overflow menu the real page doesn't show.

theme.setting: Settings › Appearance (theme mode, light theme, dark theme)
theme.generated: node spikes/variants/primer-packs.mjs <@primer/primitives package> <out>: one blank page per theme with only that theme's CSS (@primer/primitives 11.10.0, MIT, © GitHub Inc.)
fallbacks: Avatars, images and syntax colors drawn as images keep their colors
Pages GitHub hasn't moved to Primer's functional variables keep their literal colors

writes.what: Comment (on an issue or pull request) posts it

steps: You: delete the comment "{comment}" (its options menu › Delete)

check.expect: The conversation has no comment from the run.

writes.what: Commit changes (the web editor) commits to the branch
writes.note: Undo is a revert commit or resetting the branch outside the browser: the demo's reset does it with git.

check.expect: The branch's head is the commit the demo starts from.

writes.what: Confirm merge merges the pull request
writes.note: A merged pull request stays merged; demos record against a throwaway pull request, made again by the reset.

check.expect: The pull request the demo starts with is open.
Nothing to undo; the notification has gone.

effects.what: Comments, reviews and merges notify watchers (by email too)

check.expect: Record in a repository only the demo's accounts watch.

notes: Primer ships both of the account's chosen themes in every page, so light and dark flip without a pack; the other 12 themes come from themes/. repairs/css.json: CSS declarations Chrome's CSSOM drops when GitHub's CSS overrides part of a var() shorthand (each captured rule is one line; a line found in the map is swapped whole).
